title: OpenCode Go × TIMETOACT LLM Benchmark report
description: One average OpenCode Go task (a full session) priced against the latest TIMETOACT LLM Benchmark issue. Generated by the opencode-benchmark script; do not edit by hand.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the run that produced this file.

generator.description: Who produced this file. Consumers reusing the data should credit it.

page.description: Deployed page URL; null when generated without a known deployment target.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the generating project.

sources.description: Where every number in this report comes from. Consumers who republish this report must keep this block.

title.description: What was taken from this source (tariff prices and quotas).

url.description: URL of the OpenCode Go pricing page.
URL of the exact monthly issue used for the scores in this report.

indexUrl.description: Index page listing all monthly issues (the script picks the newest).

copyright.description: Copyright notice of the benchmark publisher.

series.description: Identifier of the benchmark series this report scores against.

issue.description: Slug of the newest issue, e.g. "september-2026".

issues.description: Number of issues kept in the benchmark history (docs/benchmarks/<series>/).

legal.description: Legal notices that must travel with the data.

disclaimer.description: Liability/accuracy disclaimer for anyone reusing this data.

changes.description: Diff against the previous daily snapshot (docs/history/). Daily history turns the report into a time series.

vs.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the previous snapshot this diff was computed against; null for the very first snapshot.

benchmarkIssueChanged.description: True when a new monthly benchmark issue appeared since the previous snapshot.

items.description: Per-model changes: score moves, price/quota changes, tariffs added or removed.

model.description: Tariff name (as listed by OpenCode Go).

session.description: The measured session profile all costs are computed against: one average task = a full autonomous session (~147 turns), not a single request. Method and sample: docs/profiles/measured.json.

turns.description: Turns (assistant steps) per session — the measured median of root sessions.

perTurn.description: Tokens of each class per turn.

cacheReadTokens.description: Cache-read tokens per turn (~95% of processed tokens).

cacheWriteTokens.description: Tokens written to the prompt cache per turn.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens per turn (output + reasoning; both bill at the output rate).

contextTokensPerTurn.description: Tokens processed per turn (sum of the per-turn buckets) — the effective context at a mid-session turn.

cacheReadShare.description: Cache-read tokens as a fraction of processed tokens.

monthlyPoolUsd.description: Monthly quota pool in USD (OpenCode Go fixed pool).

rows.description: Every OpenCode Go tariff with computed cost metrics and its benchmark match.

model.description: Tariff name exactly as listed on the OpenCode Go pricing page.

provider.description: Provider namespace the tariff belongs to, e.g. "opencode-go"; null when unknown.

modelId.description: Authoritative provider model id resolved by exact match against the provider's own model list (opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models), e.g. "deepseek-v4.1-flash". Null means the tariff name did not exactly resolve: consumers must do their own matching and must NOT assume the model is unavailable.

score.description: TIMETOACT benchmark "final" score; null when the model was not matched.

priceUsdPerSession.description: Computed cost of one average task (a full session) in USD.

mpPerSession.description: Milli-percent of the monthly pool consumed by one session (price ÷ quota × 100 000).

quotaUsd.description: Monthly quota in USD as listed by OpenCode Go.

multiplier.description: Quota multiplier implied by the pool: 60 ÷ quotaUsd.

sessionsPerMonth.description: How many average sessions (tasks) fit into the monthly pool.

inputPerM.description: Fresh input price, USD per 1M tokens (from the tariff).

outputPerM.description: Output price, USD per 1M tokens (from the tariff).

cacheReadPerM.description: Cache-read price, USD per 1M tokens — the class carrying ~95% of the tokens in a session.

cacheWritePerM.description: Cache-write price, USD per 1M tokens (0 when the tariff does not bill cache writes).

costSplit.description: Fraction of one session bill coming from each token class (sums to 1); null when the tariff prices nothing.

input.description: Share of the bill from fresh input tokens.

cacheRead.description: Share of the bill from cache-read tokens.

cacheWrite.description: Share of the bill from cache-write tokens.

output.description: Share of the bill from output tokens.

matchedBenchmarkName.description: Benchmark row name matched to this tariff; null if unmatched.

similarity.description: Levenshtein similarity of the normalized names; null if unmatched.

tier.description: Match confidence: OK ≥ 0.85 or substring rescue; AMBIG 0.55–0.85; WEAK 0.50–0.55; NONE — no match.

benchmarkIssue.description: Issue slug that measured the matched row, e.g. "march-2026"; null if unmatched. Null also implies the newest issue.

benchmarkFallback.description: True when the matched score comes from an older issue (the newest one does not carry this model).

peakHours.description: Peak/Off-Peak pricing hours for this tariff as stated by OpenCode Go (e.g. DeepSeek V4). null when the note does not apply.

tz.description: Timezone the stated hours are in (always UTC so far).

days.description: Inclusive weekday range using JS getDay numbering (0=Sunday); null when every day is affected.

items.description: One peak window as [fromHour, fromMinute, toHour, toMinute] in tz.

ranges.description: Peak hour windows within the weekday range; all other hours (incl. weekends) are Off-Peak.

ranked.description: Top tariffs by benchmark score per milli-percent of quota; confident matches only.

model.description: Tariff name as listed on the OpenCode Go pricing page.

mpPerSession.description: Milli-percent of the monthly pool consumed by one session.

scorePerMp.description: score ÷ mp — intelligence per consumed fraction of the pool.
